name: Skin Texture Realism
description: Analyzes skin micro-文本ure and pore detail for realism
algorithm: Skin Texture Realism — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes skin texture characteristics for video deepfake detection:

1. **Multi-Scale皮肤纹理提取**: Skin texture is analyzed at multiple scales using Gabor filters and Local Binary Pattern (LBP) descriptors. The texture hierarchy captures: macro-texture (wrinkles, expression lines), meso-texture (pores, fine wrinkles), and micro-texture (skin grain, cell patterns).

2. **纹理Quality评估**: Natural skin texture shows characteristic statistical properties at each scale — specific kurtosis, spatial autocorrelation, and frequency content. The method evaluates texture quality against natural skin models. AI-generated skin often shows: over-smoothed texture (lost high-frequency detail), artificial periodicity, or textures that don't scale correctly with resolution.

3. **Regional纹理一致性**: Different facial regions have different texture characteristics (nose more textured than cheeks). These regional differences should be physically motivated and consistent across the face. The method maps texture distribution and checks for anomalies — AI generators may produce inconsistent regional texture, particularly at the boundaries between separately generated regions.

4. **纹理-ExpressionInteraction**: During expressions, skin texture changes predictably: wrinkles deepen, pores stretch across tension lines, and skin becomes smoother in compressed regions. The method verifies texture-expression correspondence. Deepfakes may show expressions without corresponding texture changes.

5. **时间纹理稳定性**: Fixed skin texture elements (pores, stable wrinkles, moles) should maintain consistent positions across frames. The method tracks landmark texture features over time — temporal texture instability indicates per-frame independent rendering characteristic of AI generation.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through skin 文本ure realism analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频
